links.outcome: Rationale faithfulness and prediction performance of evidence-grounded generation versus full-context LLM and RAG baselines
links.effect: EviGen improves prediction performance and rationale faithfulness over full-context LLM and RAG baselines across three medical prediction datasets; clinical reviewers preferred it in a usability evaluation.
links.quote: Across three medical prediction datasets, EviGen improves prediction performance and rationale faithfulness over full-context LLM and RAG baselines, and is preferred by clinical reviewers in a usability evaluation.

unlisted_practices: Process-supervised step-level verifier that flags unreliable claims in generated clinical rationales
Patient-conditioned retriever ranking EHR evidence by prediction attribution scores rather than textual relevance

screen.reason: The study develops and tests a framework incorporating verifiable rationale generation and step-level automated verification (flagging unreliable claims) to mitigate hallucination, evaluated against baselines and through clinician usability review.

primary.practice: process-supervised verifier and grounded evidence scaffolding
